title: duomi super tools
description: This mod was created with MCreator and adds five different super tools that can help you progress faster while saving inventory space.
body: When you possess iron tools, would you discard stone tools? Wait a moment. Once you download this mod, you will find that it unlocks four crafting recipes. When you craft them — the Super Stone Pickaxe, Super Stone Axe, Super Stone Sword, and Super Stone Shovel — you will find that they offer extremely fast mining efficiency along with exceptionally high damage and durability. Finally, you will discover that you have unlocked one more recipe: the Hammer of Infinity. It possesses unlimited durability and very high damage. Although its efficiency is not high, it can help you save a significant amount of inventory space.
